title: Bloxy Cola
body:
"Warning: Bloxy Cola may be habit-forming."

The Bloxy Cola item can be bought at the Classic Store for $737.

There is a chance that you will find a red X on the bottom of a can.

Trivia

  • It is an equip-able gear item that can be bought in the Roblox catalog for 50 robux, officially added in May 5th, 2009. It heals 5 HP after a 3 second drinking animation.
